tools.name: get_availability
tools.description: Check dorm bed-place availability and price for a date range at Aurinia XO (Kamianets-Podilskyi) — bed-places only, no room types. Read-only. check_out is optional (defaults to check_in + 1 night). Accepts an optional promo_code (e.g. BOT5), which yields the discounted price.
